resources.string: Start a match, add the players and tap a cell to score. Everything stays on your phone.
The scores of this match will be erased. This can\'t be undone.
Any game. Type the points each round and choose whether the highest or the lowest total wins.
For grid card games with cards from −2 to 12. Tap the cards left in each grid; whoever ends the round scores double if not the lowest. The game ends at 100 and the lowest total wins.
For flip-and-bust card games. Pick the number cards (0–12), bonus cards and ×2. A bust scores 0 and 7 number cards earn +15. The game ends at 200.
The classic 13-category scorecard. Tap the dice and the score is calculated for you; +35 bonus when the upper section reaches 63.
Lowest total after 9 rounds wins. You can change the number of rounds.
Add each player\'s penalty points per hand. The game ends when someone reaches 100; the lowest total wins.
Whoever dominoes scores the pips left in the opponents\' hands. The game ends when someone reaches 100.
Brazilian style, usually in pairs: each hand scores by the kind of domino (simple, double, both ends, cross). First to 6 wins.
Paulista truco: each hand is worth 1, 3, 6, 9 or 12. Two sides; first to 12 wins.
%s starts! The turn order was rotated to match.
This game allows up to %d players.
Tap the value of each card left in the grid
Ended the round (doubles if not the lowest)
Tap the five dice. Tap a die above to remove it.
Tap a filled cell to fix or delete a score.
The undo arrow reverts the last change.
The trophy shows the standings at any time, and you can keep playing after the result.
Matches are saved: close the app and come back later.
Tap a player\'s cell in a round to type the points. Use ± for negative values.
No need to type zeros: leave empty whoever didn\'t score.
When creating the match you choose whether the highest or lowest total wins and, optionally, a target that ends the game.
At the end of each round, tap the player\'s cell and tap the value of each card left in their grid, or use \"Type total\".
Tick \"Ended the round\" for whoever revealed all cards first. If their round score is positive and not the lowest, it doubles; the board shows ×2.
When someone reaches 100 at the end of a round, the game ends. Lowest total wins.
When a player stops or busts, tap their cell.
Tap the number cards they hold, the bonus cards (+2 to +10) and ×2 if they have it. ×2 doubles only the number cards.
7 different number cards add +15 automatically. If they busted, tick \"Bust\" and the round scores 0.
When someone reaches 200 at the end of a round, the game ends. Highest total wins.
Each row is a category. On your turn, tap the cell of the category you want to use.
Tap the five dice on the table; the app calculates the points for that category.
If they don\'t fit anything, use \"Scratch (0)\" on a free category.
The Bonus row tracks the upper section: 63 points earn +35. The game ends when everyone fills all 13 categories.
At the end of each round, tap each player\'s cell and type the points of their cards.
Negative cards? Use ± on the keypad.
After the agreed number of rounds (9 by default), the lowest total wins.
When someone goes out, tap each player\'s cell and type the points of the cards left in their hand.
Whoever went out can stay empty (0).
When someone reaches 100 at the end of a hand, the game ends. Lowest total wins.
Whoever dominoes scores the pips left in the opponents\' hands: tap their cell and type the total.
If the game is blocked, whoever has the fewest pips scores the others\' total.
Only the winner of the hand scores. The game ends as soon as someone reaches the target (100 by default).
Playing in pairs, add each pair as one player (e.g. \"Us\" and \"Them\").
Each hand, tap the cell of whoever dominoed and pick the kind: simple +1, double +2, both ends +3, cross +4, blocked game +1.
Values vary by region: use \"Type value\" if your table plays differently.
First to 6 wins. You can change the target when creating the match.
Add the two teams (or the two players) as players, e.g. \"Us\" and \"Them\".
Each hand, tap the cell of the winning side and pick what it was worth: regular +1, truco +3, six +6, nine +9, twelve +12. If the other side folds, score what the hand was worth before the raise.
Hand of eleven: the side with 11 may look at the partner\'s cards and decide to play for 3; if they fold, the opponents score 1.
First to 12 wins. Playing another variant? Use \"Type value\" and set the target when creating the match.
